title: Coco Pandan Syrup
ldKeywords: Simple syrup from pandan leaves and coconut water
Using leftover pulverized pandan leaves from making pandan extract to make simple syrup
ldIngredientsRaw: 250 ml coconut water (Indonesian: air kelapa muda)
4 tablespoon pandan leaf pulp (or 5 pandan leaves) (*)
ldInstructionsRaw: Place all ingredients in a sauce pot and bring to a boil. Keep cooking until the liquid has thickened slightly. You can control how thick or thin you want your syrup to be.
Turn off heat, and strain into clean jar(s). Let it cool to room temperature, then store in the fridge and consumed within 1 month.
